Coding agent risks with Azure: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Azure: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Read an Azure CLI token cache

    Fix: Add a deny rule such as Read(~/.azure/**) to the Claude Code settings, which covers accessTokens.json and msal_token_cache.*, and run the agent in a container or as a separate OS user that cannot see ~/.azure. A Read rule also covers shell commands such as cat, but not a script that opens the file itself, so enable the Claude Code sandbox when the block must hold.

    Replay result: Stopped.
